title: Boston Tea Party and Revolutionary War

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte die Fragen.

atoms.text: The colonies in the East of North America were ruled by the Great British government. In order to receive goods from their home country, the colonists had to pay taxes. After some years of paying taxes, they didn't want to do that anymore. They wanted more than the goods from home – they wanted to be represented in the Great British government too. The Great British government decided to end almost all taxes but kept them on tea. That's why the colonists refused ships that brought tea to unload in harbours. Only in Boston Harbor they were still allowed to unload.

atoms.a: The colonists wanted to pay taxes to Great Britain.
The Great British government kept taxes on tea.

atoms.text: On the 16th December 1773, 60 British colonists protested against the taxes on tea. At night, they went to Boston Harbor and pushed more than 300 chests of tea into the water. To punish the colonists, the Great British government made them pay for the tea that was ruined during the protest. The Great British government also closed the harbour and established new laws for the colonies. This led to the “Revolutionary War” that took place from 1775 to 1783.

atoms.a: The “Boston Tea Party” was a protest, not a party.
The Great British government's punishment of the colonisers led to the “Civil Rights Movement”.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.a: Die britischen Kolonisten waren über die Bestrafungen durch die Regierung Großbritanniens nach der “Boston Tea Party” nicht erfreut.
atoms.b: The ((++British Dutch)) colonists weren't happy about the ((++punishments voyages)) from the Great British government after the “Boston Tea Party”.

atoms.a: Deshalb rebellierten sie weiter gegen die Regierung von Großbritannien. Frankreichs Regierung und die französischen Kolonisten halfen den britischen Kolonisten.
atoms.b: That's why they kept ((++rebelling crying)) against the Great British government. Even the French government and the ((++French German)) colonists helped the British colonists.

atoms.a: Einige Kolonisten kamen in Philadelphia zusammen und diskutierten, wie sie gegen die Regierung Großbritanniens vorgehen könnten.
atoms.b: Several ((++colonists painters)) came together in Philadelphia and ((++discussed screamed)) how to react to the Great British government.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.a: Die Regierung Großbritanniens reagierte auf die Diskussionen in Philadelphia und schickte Truppen zu den Kolonien. Diese sollten den Kolonien militärische Ausrüstung wegnehmen.
atoms.b: The Great British government ((++reacted reached)) to the discussions in Philadelphia and sent troops to the colonies. They were supposed to ((++take_away bring)) military supplies from the colonies.

atoms.a: So begann der “Revolutionary War”. Er ist auch als “War of Independence” bekannt, weil die britischen Kolonien durch ihn unabhängig von der Regierung Großbritanniens wurden.
atoms.b: This is how the “Revolutionary War” ((++started ended)). It is also known as “War of Independence”, because the British colonies became ((++independent individual)) from Great Britain as a result.

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Text, indem du die Lücken füllst.

atoms.a: Die Unabhängigkeit wurde am 4. Juli 1776 beschlossen und die 13 Kolonien wurden zu den Vereinigten Staaten von Amerika. Der Krieg dauerte noch bis 1781 an.
atoms.b: ((++Independence Intellect)) was declared on July 4, 1776, and the 13 colonies ((++became got)) the United States of America. The war continued until 1781.

atoms.a: 1783 musste die Regierung von Großbritannien den “Frieden von Paris” unterschreiben und die Unabhängigkeit der USA offiziell anerkennen.
atoms.b: In 1783, the Great British government had to sign the “((++Treaty_of_Paris Treaty_of_Amsterdam))” and officially accepted the independence of the USA.
